profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Designing and maintaining underlying data model and data systems for the application stack, engineering batch and streaming data pipelines for analytics and machine learning.  Design, architecture, and implementation of ETL/ELT frameworks.  Supporting devops.  Owning the challenging and mundane database administration tasks. Making slow things faster and more efficient.  Creating then evangelizing standards and best practices for the data world.  Having opinions on systems and application architecture. Writing overly verbose documentation then trying to distill it into pictures and diagrams. That's my game.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built Datalake from scratch including:
• Kubernetes native model serving and FEAST feature store.
• MLOps, enabling efficient infrastructure as code practices.
•  Distributed processing with DASK for improved data processing capabilities.
• ETL pipelines including change data capture, orchestration, and monitoring/alerting.

positions.title: Principal Data Engineer
positions.description:
• Led software and infrastructure engineering for the data lake platform team at Liberty Mutual Insurance.
• Designed CICD capabilities for Kafka Connect connectors and introduced containerization technologies.
• Implemented monitoring and alerting via Datadog integrations and prototype agent/control plane paradigm using TCP socket connections.
positions.insights: Skills: Atlassian Bamboo · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Apache NiFi · Maven · Amazon Elastic MapReduce (EMR) · Amazon Athena · Docker · Snowflake · Apache Kafka · Spring Boot · Java · Hive

positions.title: Staff Data Engineer
positions.description:
• Led integration of disparate business units into common domain model with micro service architecture restructuring.
• Introduced Kafka technologies for data lake formation using GCS/Avro/Bigquery.
• Refactored identity resolution into real-time implementations for business use cases.
positions.insights: Skills: Helm Charts · Maven · Microservices · Kubernetes · Database Design · Docker · Apache Kafka · PostgreSQL · Kotlin · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Java

positions.title: Senior Data Engineer
positions.description:
• Supported analysts, data scientists, and ML platform team with data pipeline technologies and devops assistance.
• Guided best practices and taught query performance tuning for both analysts and engineering organization.
• Migrated entire data infrastructure across AWS accounts and regions, defining architecture and technology selection process.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Amazon Kinesis · Kubernetes · Python (Programming Language) · AWS Lambda · MySQL · Data Build Tool (DBT) · Docker · Apache Kafka · Amazon Redshift

positions.title: Engineering Director, Architect
positions.description:
• Led multiple teams in developing core technologies and infrastructure at Porch.
• Organized assets to deliver data science features and build data warehousing systems.
• Defined incident management policies and implemented on-call rotations for asset availability.

positions.title: Director of Data Engineering
positions.description:
• Led a team of data engineers at Porch, designing top-level entities in the domain model to support home improvement products.
• Directed the development of Restful Java API endpoints to expose core features as a platform.
• Implemented security measures by sequestering data and isolating access at the API layer during migration to a micro-service strategy.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Engineered event-driven master data management process for data ingestion pipelines.
• Designed scalable system for transactionally and eventually consistent use cases.
• Evaluated infrastructure performance within AWS for scalability and optimized configurations for best transactional throughput.

positions.title: Senior Vice President, Information Technology
positions.description:
• Led partnership with Microsoft on market research and competitive analysis for Bing, resulting in a better understanding of consumer search behavior.
• Oversaw the development and deployment of technology products, ensuring company growth and success.
• Defined and implemented the vision and technology for key projects with major clients, showcasing leadership and technical expertise.

positions.title: Director of Information Technology
positions.description:
• Led software development teams and IT operations to support new product development and infrastructure revitalization.
• Designed a system to process data from end user HTTP headers into clickstream data for behavioral analysis.
• Led ISO-27000 series compliance efforts, including external audits for physical data centers and cloud integrations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and implemented a sample aggregation process with enhanced security measures to improve data quality for a seamless panel aggregation process.
• Developed a digital fingerprinting system to prevent account duplication and ensure unique user participation, resulting in improved user experience.
• Managed multiple PostgreSQL databases and outsourced Oracle services as a DBA for enhanced data management at Luth Research.

positions.title: UXO Tech II
positions.description: Performed environment remediation to remove explosive hazards and reduce insurgent terrorism capabilities while contracted as a member of an Unexploded Ordnance (UXO) removal team.  Directly managed up to 15 local nationals during the conduct of daily operations.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description: Managed client relations while executing data collection projects to include sampling, survey programming, fielding, and data delivery.  Developed custom survey programming techniques to meet expanded client expectations.

positions.title: UXO Tech II
positions.description: Performed oversight to mitigate explosive hazards from unexploded military ordnance during initial phases of the construction of Marshall Middle School in Scripps Ranch, San Diego, CA.

positions.title: Explosive Ordnance Disposal Team Leader
positions.description: Led an EOD team in multiple environments including combat and counter-terrorism operations overseas as well as providing operational assistance and supporting the training of local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies in antiterrorism initiatives.  Highly trained with a specialized focus on weapons of mass destruction with an emphasis in access and disablement.

organizations.name: San Diego Mensa
organizations.description: Board member and officer for local Mensa chapter
